test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: I have spent a good bit of my career arguing for the virtues of solitude.
I have spent a good bit of my career argueing for the virtues of solitude.
I have spent a good bit of my career arguing for the virtues of soletude.
I have spent a good bit of my carier arguing for the virtus of solitude.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arguing"** means to present reasons for or against something; it is the correct form of the verb "argue" when used in a continuous tense. (तर्क करना)

 
 
• **Example: **They were arguing about the best way to solve the problem.
 
 
 
• **"Solitude"** refers to the state of being alone, often by choice, and is usually considered peaceful or pleasant. (एकांत)
 
 
• **Example: **He enjoyed the solitude of the mountains.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Argueing** (गलत वर्तनी): The correct spelling is "arguing."

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: They were argueing about the best way to solve the problem.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Soletude** (गलत वर्तनी): The correct spelling is "solitude."
 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect usage: He enjoyed the soletude of the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Carier, virtus** (गलत वर्तनी): The correct spellings are "career" and "virtues."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: I have spent a good bit of my carier arguing for the virtus of solitude.
